verdict.rationale: Gumloop is documented as a cloud-hosted agent platform. The evidence shows remote invocation via API, SDKs and webhooks, and code execution in an isolated cloud sandbox. Nothing documents running workflows locally, a local runtime or emulator, or a separate dev/staging instance for development and CI testing. The local installer under ~/.gumloop only installs the SDK client, and team-scoped API keys are not described as a dev-environment mechanism.
